name: Max
self_text: I’m Max, a Korean woman in my early 20s studying engineering. In my free time I love amateur astronomy—I enjoy stargazing at night from a quiet hilltop. I’m looking for someone to practice language skills with, to work through problems together, and to share occasional short exchanges. We’ll keep it light and friendly—no tutoring on either side. We can meet in person or online, whatever feels comfortable. I’m free Saturday mornings or Sunday afternoons, so we can plan a session around those times. I like a relaxed vibe, curious conversation, and the thrill of discovering something new together.

requests.request_text: I must have a partner who is into working through problems together or a step‑by‑step walkthrough session; I’d strongly prefer that you are okay with talking things through as we go or occasional short exchanges, though it’s not a requirement; a nice bonus would be if you’re available Saturday morning or Sunday afternoon, and it would be great if you’re into language practice.

I need you to be into a step-by-step walkthrough session—this time, not just working through problems together as usual. Nice if you are available either Saturday morning or Sunday afternoon, and a small bonus if you are into language practice.
